verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Fly.io runs apps in regions worldwide and routes users to the nearest server over a global Anycast network. That is multi-region compute routing, not a documented CDN or edge-caching feature for static assets. Nothing in the pack describes static asset caching at the edge, so this adjacent capability earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching
